scope: EOS R5 full RAW CR3 first; associated XMP and stored previews. C-RAW and Dual Pixel RAW are secondary.

cases.title: Full RAW baseline and recognition
cases.needs: Lawfully supplied EOS R5 full RAW originals with declared and observed camera/mode/firmware; record unknowns.
cases.assertions: Read-only hash unchanged; content-based recognition; absent/misleading extensions handled; source facts and declarations remain distinct.

cases.title: Camera and capture variation
cases.needs: Distinct firmware, lens and capture settings where available; optional Canon fields observed rather than assumed.
cases.assertions: Model/layout dispatch and optional fields retain identity; CameraInfo naming and shutter-count meaning are correct for the tested subset.

cases.title: CMT and CTMD duplicates
cases.needs: Originals with observed CMT/CTMD overlaps; controlled derivative only if originals do not expose the required conflict.
cases.assertions: Every occurrence survives canonical comparison; no first-value selection; normal CR3 extraction includes observed CTMD.

cases.title: Exact values and unknown fields
cases.needs: Actual rational/numeric examples plus model-only edge vectors; retain undecoded blocks and provenance.
cases.assertions: Raw representation and normalized equality are separate; no float rounding, dropped unknown bytes or invented defaults.

cases.title: Timestamp and timezone behavior
cases.needs: Known and absent offsets, fractional precision, boundary dates; controlled UTC and America/New_York runs.
cases.assertions: CR3 integer-time interpretation is tested independently of EXIF local time; timezone changes affect only declared representations.

cases.title: GPS presence and absence
cases.needs: GPS-present and GPS-absent cases with privacy-reviewed coordinates; declare how GPS was introduced.
cases.assertions: Reference/hemisphere/altitude/time components survive; a limited scan cannot establish absent location information.

cases.title: All observed preview resources
cases.needs: Enumerate THMB, PRVW and JPEG-track assets actually present in each fixture; include missing optional forms.
cases.assertions: Extracted bytes and lengths match; resource/document identities stay distinct; nested metadata coverage is explicit.

cases.title: Embedded XMP and sidecar conflict
cases.needs: Absent/existing embedded packets, matching/conflicting sidecars, stale/orphan/ambiguous pairs.
cases.assertions: Never silently merge origins or choose the newest timestamp as authority; compare conflicts and pairing failures.

cases.title: XMP typed structures and encodings
cases.needs: Generated project-owned XMP: bags with duplicates, sequences, structures, language alternatives, qualifiers, unknown namespaces and text encodings.
cases.assertions: Shape, multiplicity, expanded names, empty/null/absent distinction and unknown properties survive; invalid text gets diagnostics.

cases.title: Corrupt container bounds and references
cases.needs: Deterministic truncation, invalid/overflow lengths, out-of-range offsets, overlapping spans and cycles; every mutation has lineage.
cases.assertions: Bounded failure, no writes/network/execution; no false successful completeness; diagnostic codes remain attributable.

cases.title: Out-of-scope and ambiguous input
cases.needs: Tiny owned signature cases and lawful CRM/other-camera inputs only when needed; negative tests do not add format support.
cases.assertions: Reject unsupported/ambiguous inputs explicitly; CRX brand alone does not grant CR3 or EOS R5 support.

cases.title: Resource limits and cancellation
cases.needs: Bounded generated nesting/size/count/encoded-output cases and deterministic cancellation triggers.
cases.assertions: Ceilings are enforced before allocation/effects; timeout/limit outcomes are incomplete, not missing metadata; record actual limit values.

cases.title: Paths, streams and platform boundaries
cases.needs: Spaces, Unicode, leading hyphens, per-platform long/case/newline paths, seekable/nonseekable input and broken output pipes.
cases.assertions: Equivalent semantic outcomes across declared OS/architecture cells; native restrictions and unsupported scenarios are explicit.

cases.title: Reports and mixed batch failures
cases.needs: Good/bad/empty-selected batches and declared report/import formats; duplicate keys are prohibited in captured JSON parsing.
cases.assertions: Per-file outcomes, summary counts and exit behavior agree; machine stdout is valid; diagnostics stay separate.

cases.title: Request framing and state isolation
cases.needs: Ordered requests with changed options, successful and failing commands, EOF and cancellation.
cases.assertions: Completion is not success; IDs/frame boundaries match; queued writes/options never leak unintentionally between requests.

cases.title: Sidecar creation and edits
cases.needs: Fresh and existing sidecars with scalar/list/structure/language updates; originals are immutable fixtures.
cases.assertions: RAW whole-file hash unchanged; exact intended XMP changes; collisions/unsupported conversions refuse; unselected data retained.

cases.title: Copy, mapping and import
cases.needs: RAW-to-XMP and supported reverse mappings; stale source, missing values, ambiguous duplicates and explicit deletion intent.
cases.assertions: Destination and losses are explicit; raw/display/normalized layers are not confused; source changes invalidate saved assumptions.

cases.title: Embedded descriptive EXIF operations
cases.needs: Separately test update, absent-field insertion and targeted removal for allowed CMT1/CMT2 fields.
cases.assertions: Independent readback and structure/payload checks pass per operation; no implied all-EXIF write support.

cases.title: Embedded GPS operations
cases.needs: Existing GPS and absent-directory cases with coupled reference/version fields; known location residuals.
cases.assertions: Insertion differs from update; targeted removal and remaining copies are reported; preservation checks gate every edit.

cases.title: Embedded XMP operations
cases.needs: Update/create/delete cases for packets and complex properties; control padding/layout changes.
cases.assertions: Requested changes only; unknown properties and sensor/preview bytes survive; all relocated references remain valid.

cases.title: Maker-note edits and known refusals
cases.needs: Individually selected maker-note candidates, direct CTMD read-only fields and unsupported preview/IPTC/ICC insertions.
cases.assertions: A correct refusal can pass its refusal test; it does not count as implementing the refused mutation. No misplaced duplicate blocks.

cases.title: Preservation and independent usability
cases.needs: A full protected-region/reference map, before/after sample hashes, unselected metadata checks and an independent reader/decoder per variant.
cases.assertions: No sensor recompression; every protected payload and dependency checked; inability to prove preservation blocks write claims.

cases.title: Mutation faults and stale sources
cases.needs: Deterministic failure points for output staging, verification and replacement; disk/permission/conflict/cancellation scenarios.
cases.assertions: Originals remain recoverable; partial outcomes are explicit; no falsely successful write. Exact transaction policies come from #0006.

cases.title: Privacy inspection and selective removal
cases.needs: Privacy-reviewed fixtures with declared sensitive tags, alternate locations and opaque regions; sidecar-only and embedded targets.
cases.assertions: Residual and uninspectable data remains visible; no anonymization claim from a clean sidecar; required rendering data survives.

cases.title: Paired file organization
cases.needs: Same basenames in different directories, case-only/cross-volume moves, collisions, timestamps and interrupted pair changes.
cases.assertions: Explicit pair mapping, per-file outcomes and recovery; metadata and filesystem claims are compared separately.

cases.title: Date and GPS workflows
cases.needs: Owned auxiliary tracks, clock offsets/drift, gaps/out-of-range samples and supported time shifts.
cases.assertions: Declared tolerances are field/unit specific; missing zones and unmatched times fail visibly; destinations and source bytes remain controlled.

cases.title: C-RAW secondary coverage
cases.needs: Separately identified EOS R5 C-RAW originals with provenance and capture-mode evidence.
cases.assertions: No inheritance of full RAW results; does not gate first full-RAW read milestone.

cases.title: Dual Pixel RAW secondary preservation
cases.needs: Separately identified Dual Pixel RAW captures; user use is not assumed; inventory extra sensor data/references.
cases.assertions: All extra protected data receives independent preservation evidence before any write eligibility.

cases.title: Admission, licensing and privacy controls
cases.needs: Manifest examples for cleared, quarantined, denied and restricted material, plus derivative lineage.
cases.assertions: Unreviewed/denied assets cannot enter runnable/public corpus; a project MIT license never relabels third-party media permissions.
